notes: 'DAY-OF-WEEK ... unsigned elementary numeric integer ONE digit ... usage display. 1 represents Monday ... 7 represents Sunday.' AcceptSource.DayOfWeek() returns `((int)Now().DayOfWeek + 6) % 7 + 1`. Checked the remap against .NET's DayOfWeek (Sunday=0 .. Saturday=6) for every value: Sunday 0 -> (6%7)+1 = 7; Monday 1 -> (7%7)+1 = 1; Tuesday 2 -> 2; Wednesday 3 -> 3; Thursday 4 -> 4; Friday 5 -> 5; Saturday 6 -> (12%7)+1 = 6. That is exactly the standard's Monday=1 .. Sunday=7 numbering, and the result is always 1..7 so the one-digit unsigned width holds. EmitAcceptTemporal maps the kind to width 1 (`_ => ("AcceptSource.DayOfWeek()", 1)` -- the default arm, which is safe because AcceptKind.Device is dispatched away by EmitAccept before EmitAcceptTemporal is reached).
